04_platform_installers.name: nightly_home_performance
04_platform_installers.note: Scenes 13_current_nightly_home and 14_current_nightly_performance in the real app (capture_install_nightly.py). The other lesson 04 scenes stay with capture_pip_installation.py (desktop driver).

05_home.name: startup_sequence
05_home.note: Scene 01_startup_sequence: launch, logo (2 s hold, 4 s blow-away), Home. Needs the capture_host_mode.py change that begins the recording before the app window exists (proposed in the hand-off report); run_native_capture refuses --splash without --record-startup. Not part of the lesson 05 scene list yet.

24_plaque.name: plaque_zoo
24_plaque.note: Scenes 03-08 settings tour, 09, 11, 12c, 18, 19, 21-23 (capture_plaque.py + plaque_native_views.py). Downloads the plaque model from the Model Zoo (network).

24_plaque.name: plaque_current
24_plaque.note: Scenes 16b_overlay_settings, 20_help_route, 30_figure_mode, 30b_from_a_paper, 31_figure_wells, 32_figure_all_wells (capture_plaque_current.py). 30b needs SPACR_TUTORIAL_PLAQUE_PAPER=<open-access DOI> in env (optional SPACR_TUTORIAL_PLAQUE_FIGURE); without it the PDF drop route runs and 30b is skipped. Needs network for the detector download.

25_recruitment.name: recruitment
25_recruitment.note: Scenes 19_setting_* (settings tour), 21_batch_running, 25_recruitment_figure_02/04, 26_recruitment_console_counts (capture_recruitment.py). Needs <SPACR_TUTORIAL_WORKSPACE>/../test_datasets/spacr/tutorials (present at /media/carruthers/mnt3/claude/toxoplasma_projects/test_datasets/spacr/tutorials); WORKSPACE was hard-coded to /mnt/firecuda2 before this change.

54_qc_dashboard.name: qc_dashboard
54_qc_dashboard.note: Inputs assembled from refresh_2026-09-09: annotate_fresh/example_data/plate1/measurements, example_data/plate1/{measurements,qc}, example_data/plate1/test/{measurements,qc} (the three sources capture_qc.py reads).

64_gate_editor.name: gate_editor
64_gate_editor.note: Reads annotate_fresh/example_data/plate1/measurements/measurements.db (2341 cells) and works on a private copy.

69_dose_response.name: dose_response
69_dose_response.note: Disclosed synthetic CSV written by dose_response_evidence.prepare; no input data. Optional env SPACR_TUTORIAL_DOSE_SORT_BEFORE_REFIT=1 reproduces the sort-before-refit scene order.

77_embeddings.name: embeddings
77_embeddings.note: Inputs: embeddings_example/cell_png with the first sixteen crops of annotate_fresh plate1_E02 uninfected cell_png. CPU resnet18 encoder (timm weights may need network).

82_toxoplasma.name: toxoplasma
82_toxoplasma.note: No input data; opens the Plaque Assay module from its tile.

85_host_pathogen.name: host_pathogen
85_host_pathogen.note: The driver presses Load test data itself (network download of the THP-1 example into the stage); expects 97 vacuoles / 164 cells.

86_alpha_organism_modules.name: alpha_organisms
86_alpha_organism_modules.note: Turns Show alpha species on and off again on camera; Show alpha features stays off.

87_alpha_features.name: alpha_features
87_alpha_features.note: Turns Show alpha features on and off on camera, tours every alpha control. 09b needs network (Model Zoo Scan). 06_timelapse and 07b_measure_time apply the timelapse setting by code (recorded as a bypass: no user route).
